candidates.review_note: Each awake/unhidden trajectory is a line position=v*time+offset on a closed time interval, with v in {-1,0,1}. For each rat check every cat for their first simultaneous meeting in the interval intersection. Unequal velocities yield a unique meeting time; equal velocities meet throughout the overlap only when offsets agree. Twice the meeting time is integral, so all calculations and boundary comparisons use exact integers. Choose the earliest cat; the source guarantees no simultaneous cat ties. Rats do not affect cat trajectories, so processing them independently is valid. This O(NM) solution meets the stated 1000-by-1000 bounds without floating-point errors or treating sleeping/hidden endpoints as active outside their intervals.
